title: Generate a VCF 9.1 brownfield migration architecture
prompt: Implement the PowerShell module in `src/VcfArchitecture.psm1` so that `New-VcfMigrationArchitecture -InventoryPath data/estate-inventory.json -CompatibilitySnapshotPath data/compatibility-snapshot.json -OutputPath output/migration-plan.json` produces the machine-readable target architecture and ordered migration plan for the supplied brownfield VMware Cloud Foundation estate. The `VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Installer` and `VMware.Sdk.Vcf.SddcManager` PowerCLI modules are installed prerequisites: use their generated `Initialize-Vcf*` cmdlets to construct the installer and upgrade-spec portions of the result; do not vendor or replace those modules. The output must remain a VCF Installer `SddcSpec` at its top level, validate against the pinned `schemas/vcf-installer-openapi.json` from `specifications/vcf-installer/vcf-installer-openapi.json` at tag `9.1.0.0` of `vmware/vcf-api-specs`, and satisfy `schemas/migration-plan.schema.json`. It must cover every inventoried component with its current version, target, supported path, dependencies, and gates, in an executable order with no unsupported hop. The target design must place and size both domains plus VCF Operations, VCF Automation, and VCF Operations for Logs using the inventory's capacity requirements. Before implementing, genuinely research the current supported combinations and upgrade paths using live, reachable Broadcom compatibility, interoperability, release-note, and upgrade sources through your network tools. In `research-notes.md`, use one Markdown bullet per source with labeled `Title`, `Publisher`, `URL`, `Accessed`, and `Claim` fields; the claim must state the compatibility or sequencing fact you used. Do not treat the pinned compatibility snapshot as a substitute for that live research. The snapshot is the deterministic acceptance authority if the live publications have changed. Produce the architecture artifact rather than a prose recommendation. Run `python3 tests/verify.py` to verify the result.
setup_cmd: pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command '$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"; $ProgressPreference="SilentlyContinue"; foreach ($name in @("VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Installer", "VMware.Sdk.Vcf.SddcManager")) { if (-not (Get-Module -ListAvailable -Name $name | Where-Object Version -EQ ([version]"13.5.0.25380678"))) { Install-Module -Name $name -RequiredVersion 13.5.0.25380678 -Repository PSGallery -Scope CurrentUser -Force -AllowClobber -AcceptLicense } }'
